symptom: Two pages with the same qualified name, one excluded: `describe page MyModule.Portal` shows the live copy, but `show access on page MyModule.Portal` shows the excluded one and `grant view on page MyModule.Portal` changes the excluded one, leaving the live page's roles untouched (mendixlabs/mxcli#1469)
cause: #914 routed describe and create-or-replace/modify through pickLive, but the other by-name loops still took the first match in ListPages/ListMicroflows/ListNanoflows order: listAccessOnPage/Microflow/Nanoflow, execGrant/Revoke{Page,Microflow,Nanoflow}Access, execDropPage (deletes whichever twin enumerates first, so it can delete the live page) and findPageByName (ALTER PAGE)
insight: **A live-preference fix applied per command leaves the rest order-dependent** — #914 fixed the commands it was reported against and the same `for … range list { if name matches { act; return } }` shape stayed in a dozen others. When the loop body acts on the match, iterating `liveFirst(list, excluded)` gives pickLive's answer with a one-token change and no re-indent; grep `range pages {` / `range mfs {` / `range nfs {` for the remaining sites (snippets, layouts, rename/move, security-matrix paths were left out of scope). The mock fixture must put the excluded twin FIRST in list order — live-first fixtures pass against the bug. Control: make liveFirst return its input unchanged and all 13 subtests fail with the reported symptom (wrote/deleted pg-excluded, show access lists the excluded twin's roles). No multi-match warning: the executor has no shared warning channel to route it through
